invariants.rationale: tileSet is required for adding tile properties and tiles; it must be non-null.
imageResolver is invoked in both code paths, so it is expected not to be null on normal execution.
tilewidth and tileheight are used as region sizes and increments in loops; they should be positive.
firstgid is used as a base id for tile ids; tile ids must be non-negative.
tiles is iterated in the else branch, so it must be non-null for that to succeed.
